blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The House of Representatives rechanneled P115.82 billion from the executive’s spending plan, Bataan Rep. Albert “Abet” Garcia said on Monday, revising the previous P116.32 billion figure that a special panel of lawmakers reportedly finalized last month. Garcia, the senior vice chairman of the House Appropriations Committee, revealed that the realignments were about P500 million lower than originally reported by the Budget Amendments Review Sub-committee (BARSc). “The more accurate figure is P115.89 billion,” he said in a media briefing, adding that most of the amendments were from agency requests.
